textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 evs · Energy: How Things Work · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Around us things move, light up, make sounds or get warmer or cooler. Something makes this happen and we call it energy.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Around us things move, light up, make sounds or get warmer or cooler. Something makes this happen and we call it energy.
beats.speakEn: Around us things move, light up, make sounds or get warmer or cooler. Something makes this happen and we call it energy.

beats.en: Energy is what makes things move, light up, produce sound, do work and change temperature.
beats.speakEn: Energy is what makes things move, light up, produce sound, do work and change temperature.

textbookBox.concept: Activity: blow up a balloon, hold it tight and let go. The air rushing out pushes the balloon forward.

beats.en: Activity: blow up a balloon, hold it tight and let go. The air rushing out pushes the balloon forward. For the balloon air rocket, tape the balloon to a straw on a string and watch it run along the string.
beats.speakEn: Activity: blow up a balloon, hold it tight and let go. The air rushing out pushes the balloon forward. For the balloon air rocket, tape the balloon to a straw on a string and watch it run along the string.

beats.en: Rubber band guitar: stretch rubber bands over a box with a hole. When you pluck them they vibrate and make sound. This is sound energy. Thinner and thicker bands sound different.
beats.speakEn: Rubber band guitar: stretch rubber bands over a box with a hole. When you pluck them they vibrate and make sound. This is sound energy. Thinner and thicker bands sound different.

textbookBox.concept: Sun-powered water warmer: leave one cup of water in sunlight and another in shade for 15 to 20 minutes. The sunlit water is warmer. Sunlight gives us heat energy.
